Super Top-Up Health Insurance

Multiply your total medical cover to ₹50 Lakhs or ₹1 Crore for a fraction of the standard premium.

1. What is a Super Top-Up Policy?

A Super Top-Up policy acts as a secondary layer of financial protection. It kicks in once your medical bills cross a predefined threshold called a Deductible. Because you or your base policy pay the initial deductible amount, insurance companies offer high Super Top-Up coverage at extremely low premiums.

2. Regular Top-Up vs. Super Top-Up

This distinction is crucial when filing multiple claims in a single year:

  • Regular Top-Up: The deductible applies to each individual claim during the year.
  • Super Top-Up: The deductible applies to the cumulative total of all claims made throughout the policy year.

3. Ideal Strategy: The Base + Super Top-Up Combo

Combine a ₹5 Lakh or ₹10 Lakh Base Policy with a ₹40 Lakh or ₹90 Lakh Super Top-Up (matching the deductible to your base cover). This combo provides ₹50 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore in protection while saving up to 60% compared to buying a ₹1 Crore base policy alone.
